# Documentation

- [Overview](/linux-dualsense-fw-updater/llms.mdx/docs.md): Documentation for the Unofficial Linux DualSense Firmware Updater, covering the 4-step update workflow, USB requirements, and key features.
- [Getting Started & Installation](/linux-dualsense-fw-updater/llms.mdx/docs/getting-started.md): Install the Unofficial Linux DualSense Firmware Updater using portable x86_64 or aarch64 (.tar.gz) archives, or by building from source.
- [Safety, USB Permissions & Troubleshooting](/linux-dualsense-fw-updater/llms.mdx/docs/safety-and-troubleshooting.md): Firmware safety precautions, Linux udev rules for DualSense USB permissions, and troubleshooting tips for common update issues.
- [Changelog](/linux-dualsense-fw-updater/llms.mdx/docs/changelog.md): Release history, version notes, and notable changes for the Unofficial Linux DualSense Firmware Updater on Linux.
- [Licenses & Acknowledgments](/linux-dualsense-fw-updater/llms.mdx/docs/licenses.md): Attribution to nchie's original project and links to the canonical license and third-party notice files on GitHub.
